tasks.title: The Unpredictable Surge of Glaciers
paras: During most of their lives, surge glaciers behave like normal glaciers, traveling perhaps only a couple of inches per day. However, at intervals of 10 to 100 years, these glaciers move forward up to 100 times faster than usual. The surge often progresses along a glacier like a great wave, proceeding from one section to another. The increasing water pressure under the glacier might lift it off its bed, overcoming the friction between ice and rock, thus freeing the glacier, which rapidly slides downhill.

Some 800 years ago, Alaska’s Hubbard Glacier advanced toward the sea, retreated, and advanced again 500 years later. Since 1895, this seventy-mile-long river of ice has been flowing steadily toward the Gulf of Alaska at a rate of approximately 200 feet per year. In June 1986, however, the glacier surged ahead as much as 47 feet a day. Meanwhile, a western tributary, called Valerie Glacier, advanced up to 112 feet a day. Hubbard’s surge closed off Russell Fiord with a formidable ice dam, whose caged waters threatened the town of Yakutat.

About 20 similar glaciers around the Gulf of Alaska are heading toward the sea. If enough surge glaciers reach the ocean and raise sea levels, a flood of ice would surge into the Southern Sea. The additional sea ice floating toward the tropics would increase Earth’s albedo and lower global temperatures, perhaps enough to initiate a new ice age.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.A: Surge glaciers can suddenly accelerate and cause major environmental changes.
options.B: Some surge glaciers are faster than others due to regional climate conditions.
options.C: The rapid advance of glaciers may result from internal and external forces.
options.D: Alaskan glaciers surge frequently and pose risks to coastal communities.

questions.analysis: 题型：主旨题 原文定位： 第一段介绍surge glacier的突然加速特征；后文用 Hubbard 冰川为例；最后一段讲这种变化可能导致气候灾难甚至新冰河时期。 正确答案分析： 三段结构完整地展示 surge glaciers 的异常行为及其地球层面影响。 选项分析： B 只是局部内容； C 虽涉及 internal/external forces，但不是全文主旨； D 仅限于 Alaska，不够全面。

questions.stem: The word “intervals” is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 题型：词汇题 原文定位： 第一段：“at intervals of 10 to 100 years...” 正确答案分析： “intervals” 表示时间间隔，语境中指每隔几十年会发生一次。 选项分析： A records（记录）——不符； B speeds（速度）——混淆概念； C distances（距离）——语境不符。

questions.stem: Why does the author compare the surging motion of a glacier to a wave?

options.A: To describe how glacier surges can erode the coastline like ocean waves
options.B: To emphasize the sudden and continuous way the surge moves through the glacier
options.C: To show that glacier surges are caused by rising tides and sea-level changes
options.D: To suggest that glacier surges are predictable and regular, like ocean tides

questions.analysis: 题型：修辞目的题 原文定位： 第一段：“like a great wave, proceeding from one section to another.” 正确答案分析： 强调“surge”如海浪般快速而连续地传播整条冰川，而非固定区域性变化。 选项分析： A 强调破坏力，文中未提及侵蚀； C 误解为潮汐原因； D 海浪并非“predictable and regular”比喻的目的。

questions.stem: Which of the following does the author mention as a possible cause of surging glaciers?

options.B: The occurrence of unusually large ocean waves
options.D: The pressure of melt water underneath the glacier

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 原文定位： 第一段：“ The increasing water pressure under the glacier might lift it off its bed, overcoming the friction between ice and rock, thus freeing the glacier, which rapidly slides downhill.” 正确答案分析： 说明冰下融水压力可能是导致冰川突然滑动的主要因素。 选项分析： A–C 均未在此处提及或与文意不符。

questions.stem: According to the passage, what distinguishes surge glaciers from normal glaciers located nearby?

options.A: Surge glaciers tend to form only in areas affected by volcanic or tectonic activity.
options.B: Unlike normal glaciers, surge glaciers are capable of dramatically increasing their speed.
options.C: Normal glaciers have more consistent movement patterns due to their smaller size.
options.D: Surge glaciers move faster because they are located closer to the sea than normal glaciers.

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 原文定位： 第一段最后两句：“The surge often progresses along a glacier like a great wave, proceeding from one section to another. The increasing water pressure under the glacier might lift it off its bed, overcoming the friction between ice and rock, thus freeing the glacier, which rapidly slides downhill.” 提到 surge glacier 会突然变快，第一段开头normal glacier 则始终缓慢。 正确答案分析： surge glacier 的显著特征是“偶尔暴增速度”，这是与常规冰川的根本区别。 选项分析： A 并未提及 surge glacier 只出现在火山/地震区； C 没有涉及大小； D 距离海洋远近并非关键。
